generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The Departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending Bidder shall be a manufacturer/ Contractor/ Agency with Super Grade (for Karnataka State)/ Class-A (other than Karnataka State) Electrical Contractor License and shall have successfully carried out similar work (Supply of 66kV or above Current Transformer along with erection, testing & commissioning or Erection, Testing and Commissioning of 66KV or above current transformers without supply) in any Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations. In this regard, the intending bidder shall have successfully carried out the said work as Prime Contractor in a single Work done of value not less than Rs.14.69 Lakhs (exclusive of GST) in Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations in last preceding five financial years (Financial Year 2020-21 to 2024-25) and shall furnish copy of the related Work order and Work done certificate issued by the competent authority and Electrical Contractor License as documentary evidence. The cost of completed works of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to the current year price level.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Super Grade (for Karnataka State)/ Class-A (other than Karnataka State) Electrical Contractor License certificate

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name shall have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual turnover of Rs.29.39 Lakhs (exclusive of GST) in the last preceding five years (i.e., Financial Year 2020-21 to 2024-25) and furnish annual turnover certificate OR Profit & Loss statements duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. Financial Turnover of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Supply, Dismounting, Shifting, Erection, Testing and Commissioning of 66KV CTs to Generator Transformer Banks at 66KV Switchyard of Shiva HES

itemList.description: Supplying of new CT's 66KV, 0.2s class, 400-200/1-1-1-1-1A ratio, Live tank type including P & F and other charges
Supply of Copper Control cable 4C X 6 Sq.mm FRLS PVC insulated armoured copper control cable

Supply of Marshalling Box (with IP 55 degree of protection, TBs, Earthing arrangement, mounting arrangements for various
components etc.,)

Supply of Terminal Connector for CT to receive IPS Al.
Tube flexible/rigid type & Pad Clamps
Supply of pad clamps suitable for Drake ACSR Item Name: Pad clamp
Dismantling of existing 66KV 0.2 class Current Transformers including removal of end clamps & secondary wiring terminations in marshalling box, movement to the point of required location

Erection of CTs 66KV,and wiring including movement from
the point of unloading to the point of erection
Testing & Commissioning of Current Transformer Testing and commissioning of CT: Insulation resistance, polarity, ratio, excitation, Coreidentification, tan-delta & capacitance test.
Mobile Crane for CT's Dismounting, unloading, shifting towards erection point, mounting on existing structure Item Name:Mobile Hydraulic Crane 5 t capacity
Assisting in Testing and Commissioning of Current Transformer
Statutory charges as per actuals (Calibration & rating of Bank 4 Energymeters charges by cescom)
Current Transformer Wiring: Inspection of wiring, ferruling, crimping of lugs, connections in CT, marshalling box & control panel, extension of earth mat etc.,

Laying, wiring, termination of Control cables in cable ducts, erection in the switchyard of proper termination at both ends, cable marks/tag enroute, supply of all cable accessories including cable glands, terminals, identification tags, ferrule at both ends.
Releasing of exisiting Cables in the switchyard cable ducts
Miscellaneous items like fastners, lugs, pipes & patch works etc.
